evidence_statement: Local 2.3.0 preview reviewed 2026-10-10. 71 tools; 70 carry this review date after a full first-party re-verification, an adversarial check of every safety-relevant change and addition, and a cross-tool consistency pass. 47 offer a configurable route for special-category data on infrastructure the institution controls; 24 are not appropriate for it.
